description: This file implements a GStreamer pipeline source integration for the Pipecat project, defining a class that manages GStreamer pipelines for media processing, including handling frames, pipeline lifecycle, and decoding audio/video streams.

classes.name: GStreamerPipelineSource
classes.description: A frame processor that uses GStreamer pipelines as media sources, managing pipeline creation, lifecycle, and decoding for audio and video streams.

classes.name: OutputParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for GStreamer pipeline output, including video dimensions, audio sample rate, channels, and clock synchronization.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, managing pipeline start, stop, and cancellation based on frame type.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Starts the GStreamer pipeline, setting it to the PLAYING state.

methods.name: _stop
methods.description: Stops the GStreamer pipeline, setting it to the NULL state.

methods.name: _cancel
methods.description: Cancels the GStreamer pipeline, setting it to the NULL state.

methods.name: _on_gstreamer_message
methods.description: Handles messages from the GStreamer bus, logging errors.

methods.name: _decodebin_callback
methods.description: Handles new pads from decodebin, routing to audio or video setup.

methods.name: _decodebin_audio
methods.description: Sets up audio processing pipeline from decoded audio pad.

methods.name: _decodebin_video
methods.description: Sets up video processing pipeline from decoded video pad.

methods.name: _appsink_audio_new_sample
methods.description: Handles new audio samples from GStreamer appsink, creating audio frames.

methods.name: _appsink_video_new_sample
methods.description: Handles new video samples from GStreamer appsink, creating image frames.
